label: Whatever is moved in a respect of physical MOTION_2 is moved in that respect by…, by Proof-by-cases
meaning: Case analysis on Physics VIII.4's division: a moved thing is moved by force (then another moves it) or by nature; a natural motion is a self-motion (then something moves it) or the motion of something light or heavy (then its generator moves it, or the remover of a hindrance per accidens).
